objective: Novelty-screen one fully charged attack-mechanism lane and one verifiable-methodology lane, then independently review survivors before any ECDLP claim or experiment is promoted.

tasks.title: Search the fully charged ECDLP mechanism frontier

handoff.objective: Produce at most three operation-level novel prime-field ECDLP mechanisms with a credible fully charged route below matched rho and BSGS, or return a precise no-candidate frontier.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a generic-model escape, structured-curve lever, relation/descent mechanism, or multi-target tradeoff survives the complete corpus screen.
inputs: ledger, experiment, knowledge, idea, rejected/preallocation, focus, and recent review corpora
constraints: Read and deduplicate against the complete corpus before proposing a candidate.
Preserve every pre-existing dirty ideas path and write only beneath the assigned scope.
Include complete preprocessing, relation collection, linear algebra, descent, verification, memory, and multi-target costs.
Use public or toy targets only; allocate no official ID or breakthrough claim.
Record requested policy, exact resolved model, reasoning effort, fallback status, adapter version, and inspected boundary.
completion_gate: Both exact deliverables exist and bind the inspected corpus boundary.
Every survivor has mechanism, novelty predecessor, predictions, decisive test, falsification criteria, and full-path costs.
A no-candidate result preserves exactly one narrow frontier without becoming negative ECDLP evidence.
handoff.return_format: YAML verdict plus Markdown novelty and full-cost matrix.

tasks.title: Search the verifiable cryptanalytic methodology frontier

handoff.objective: Produce at most two novel decision-critical ECDLP verification or cost-model techniques, or return one precise methodological frontier.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a new certificate, accounting method, benchmark, or falsification tool can improve rigorous ECDLP research or create a credible cost-reduction path.
inputs: contracts, claims rules, harness, tools, templates, ledgers, experiments, knowledge, ideas, and reviews
constraints: Deduplicate against all existing techniques, instruments, certificates, ideas, and reviews.
Preserve every pre-existing dirty ideas path and write only beneath the assigned scope.
Reject generic workflow advice that cannot change a concrete cryptanalytic decision.
Distinguish methodological value from attack improvement and use public or toy fixtures only.
Record requested policy, exact resolved model, reasoning effort, fallback status, adapter version, and inspected boundary.
completion_gate: Both exact deliverables exist and bind the inspected corpus boundary.
Every survivor names a decision-changing uncertainty, auditable artifact, validation, failure modes, and quantitative gain.
A no-technique result preserves one precise gap without becoming cryptanalytic evidence.
handoff.return_format: YAML verdict plus Markdown decision-impact and cost audit.

tasks.title: Archive reviews and checkpoint the goal

handoff.objective: Commit independent reviews, scoped evidence, the Coordinator decision, and the goal checkpoint.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether BATCH-001 is durable and eligible for official reranking.
inputs: the four declared independent review artifacts
constraints: Run alone and validate review independence and snapshot binding.
Stage only declared paths and preserve unrelated dirty files.
Keep the goal active absent a positive completion criterion or declared pause condition.
